name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening, folks. Miami rolled Stanford, Sayin hit his deep shots, and stateoftheu.com says this locker room is already talking championship. So, legit playoff team or just a good day against bad competition, Dale?

name: DALE RUTTMAN
line: You put on the film from the Cotton Bowl...Miami didn't just win, they physically dominated Ohio State, a program that’s no stranger to playoff caliber teams. That’s proof, son.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Dale, proof? Miami’s O-line stumbled hard...no cap, they couldn’t seal the run or protect Sayin, and that linebacker crew? Question marks wide open. Playoff teams don’t get gifted that slack.

name: DALE RUTTMAN
line: Now here's the thing about that young man...when the blitz came, Miami's defense tightened knots around the quarterback. That's a habit, not a fluke. That kind of grit wins playoff nights.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, North Carolina's leading the ACC in yards and scoring right now. If that O-line and linebacker corps are really that shaky, how do the Hurricanes survive an offense like that in the playoffs?

name: DALE RUTTMAN
line: Look, son, it’s not about being flawless. Miami’s defense brought the fight, hit hard, and kept Ohio State’s offense guessing all game. That’s playoff grit right there.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, playoff grit? Stateoftheu.com and others flag Miami's defense as out of sync and the schedule soft. You can’t flex on weak foes and call it ready for the mecca.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, analysts don’t just whisper, they shout...Miami's defense got shaky against real heat, not the soft stuff. That’s the real test, and they ain't cleared it yet.

name: DALE RUTTMAN
line: I wasn't expecting that. But here’s the honest truth: Miami showed they could reset and bounce back. Even when things got rough, they made plays that matter, and that’s crucial in the playoffs.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Dale, ESPN's own model gives Miami a real edge over Clemson. Does that projection square with the shaky O-line Cassius keeps pointing to?

name: DALE RUTTMAN
line: Models can’t see what a strong arm and a sure read do on the field. Sayin connecting deep, 27 of 30, shows real poise under pressure...those throws set a playoff tone.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Here's what neither of you is naming: an arm can bail out a bad night, but it can't fix what happens up front snap after snap.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Pull up...run game still sputters, defense leaks big plays. Until Miami locks those down, they’re just a playoff hope not a team built for playoff weight.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: So that's where we sit: a live projection favoring Miami, a defense still finding itself. The next few weeks settle which story wins.
